title: चड्कनपछि तीन चेक, तर बन्द खाताको !
content:
रुपन्देही । पुरानो आर्थिक लेनदेनको विवादमा सार्वजनिक स्थानमै चड्कन खाएका बर्दियाका नेकपा नेता सुरेश पन्थले प्रहरीकै रोहबरमा साढे १९ लाख रुपैयाँका तीनवटा चेक दिए पनि ती चेक बन्द खाताका रहेको पीडितले दाबी गरेकी छन् । राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टी (रास्वपा) प्रवेश गर्ने तयारीमा रहेका पन्थलाई काठमाडौँमा भेटेपछि रकम फिर्ता माग्दै चड्कन हानेकी जानुका पौडेलले शुक्रबार बैंकमा बुझ्न जाँदा खाता बन्द रहेको जानकारी पाएको बताइन् । पन्थले प्रहरीको रोहबरमा ९ लाख ५६ हजार, ७ लाख ५० हजार र २ लाख ५० हजार रुपैयाँका चेक दिएको पौडेलको भनाइ छ । तर, चेकमा उल्लेख भएको खाताबाट रकम भुक्तानी हुन नसक्ने भएपछि आफू फेरि समस्यामा परेको उनले बताइन् । पौडेलका अनुसार पन्थले २०७९ को निर्वाचनका बेला आफूबाट रकम लिएका थिए । उनले वित्तीय संस्थाबाट ऋण निकालेर, मितेनी तथा आफन्तसँग खोजेर रकम उपलब्ध गराएको बताइन् । लामो समयसम्म रकम फिर्ता नपाएपछि पन्थ रास्वपा प्रवेश गर्न लागेको थाहा पाएर काठमाडौँस्थित पार्टी कार्यालय पुगेको उनको भनाइ छ । ‘म २०७९ को निर्वाचनपछि रास्वपामा थिएँ । निर्वाचनका बेला फाइनान्सबाट निकालेर, मितिनी र आफन्तसँग खोजेर दिएको रकम वर्षौंसम्म फिर्ता भएन । प्रहरीकहाँ बसेर हात जोड्दै चेक दिएपछि छाडेकी थिएँ । मैले ब्याज मागेको होइन, आफ्नै रकम फिर्ता पाउनुपर्छ’, पौडेलले भनिन् । आफू मात्रै नभई अरू पनि पन्थबाट पीडित रहेको दाबी गर्दै पौडेलले आफूले आवाज उठाएपछि थप पीडितहरू सम्पर्कमा आउन थालेको बताइन् । रकमको विवाद समाधान नभएसम्म पन्थलाई रास्वपा प्रवेश गर्न नदिन पार्टीका नेताहरूसँग आग्रह गरेको पनि उनले बताइन् । बर्दियामा तत्कालीन नेकपा (माओवादी) र हाल नेकपाबाट दुई पटक प्रतिनिधिसभा सदस्यका उम्मेदवार बनेका पन्थ रास्वपा प्रवेशको तयारीका क्रममा बुधबार काठमाडौँमा सार्वजनिक स्थानमै कुटिएका थिए । बर्दियाबाट नेता तथा कार्यकर्तासहित रास्वपा प्रवेश गर्न बनस्थली पुगेका पन्थलाई घण्टीघर नजिकै महिलाहरूले घेरेर हातपात गरेका थिए । पन्थ निकटस्थहरूका अनुसार निर्वाचनका बेला लिएको रकम फिर्ता नगरेको भन्दै महिलाहरूले आक्रोश पोखेका थिए । बर्दियाको मधुवन नगरपालिका–७ निवासी जानुका पौडेलसहितका महिलाले पुरानो आर्थिक लेनदेनको विषयलाई लिएर उनीमाथि हातपात गरेका थिए । सार्वजनिक भएको भिडियोमा महिलाहरूले पन्थमाथि रकम लिएर फिर्ता नगरेको र पार्टी परिवर्तन गर्दै हिँडेको भन्दै आक्रोश व्यक्त गरेको देखिन्छ । उनीहरूले यसअघि पनि प्रहरीमा उजुरी दिएको तर सुनुवाइ नभएको दाबी गरेका थिए । हातपातपछि पन्थसँग रहेका व्यक्तिहरूले महिलाहरूलाई रोक्ने प्रयास गरेका थिए । केहीबेर तनाव भएपछि प्रहरीले हस्तक्षेप गरी पन्थलाई नियन्त्रणमा लिएको र महिलाहरूलाई शान्त पारेको थियो । त्यसपछि प्रहरीकै रोहबरमा आर्थिक लेनदेन मिलाउने प्रयास भएको र पन्थले चेक दिएको बताइएको छ । पन्थ पक्षले रकम लिएको र केही भुक्तानीसमेत गरेको स्वीकार गरे पनि सार्वजनिक स्थानमा हातपात गर्न नहुने तर्क गरेको छ । निर्वाचनका बेला भएको आर्थिक कारोबारको वास्तविक विवरण र रकम भुक्तानीबारे दुवै पक्षबीच विवाद कायम छ । पन्थ २०७९ को प्रतिनिधिसभा निर्वाचनमा रेशम चौधरीका बुवासँग झिनो मतान्तरले पराजित भएका थिए । पछिल्लो निर्वाचनमा भने रास्वपाका उम्मेदवार श्रीधर पोखरेलसँग फराकिलो मतान्तरले पराजित भएका थिए । पछिल्लो समय रास्वपाको पक्षमा वकालत गर्दै आएका पन्थ पार्टी परिवर्तन गरी रास्वपा प्रवेश गर्ने तयारीमा काठमाडौं पुगेका थिए । Rupandehi. Bardiya NCP leader Suresh Pantha, who was publicly scolded over an old financial transaction dispute, handed over three checks worth Rs 1.95 million in the presence of the police, but the victim has claimed that the checks were from a closed account. Januka Poudel, who had been demanding a refund of the money after meeting Panth, who is preparing to join the National Independent Party (NISP), in Kathmandu, said that when she went to the bank on Friday to check, she was informed that the account was closed. Poudel said that Panth had given checks of Rs 956,000, Rs 750,000 and Rs 250,000 in the presence of the police. However, she said that she was in trouble again when the amount could not be paid from the account mentioned in the check. According to Poudel, Pantha had taken money from him during the 2079 elections. She said that she had taken out a loan from a financial institution and sought the money from her friends and relatives. She said that after not receiving the money back for a long time, she reached the party office in Kathmandu after learning that Pantha was going to join the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). "I was in the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) after the 2079 elections. The money I had withdrawn from finance during the elections, sought from my relatives and friends, was not returned for years. I left after sitting at the police station and giving a check with folded hands. I did not ask for interest, I should get my own money back," said Poudel. Claiming that not only she but others are victims of the cult, Poudel said that after she raised her voice, more victims started coming in contact. She also said that she has urged party leaders not to allow Panth to join the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) until the dispute over the money is resolved. Pantha, who was a two-time candidate for the House of Representatives from the then CPN (Maoist) in Bardiya and is currently a CPN member, was beaten up in a public place in Kathmandu on Wednesday while preparing to enter the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). Pantha, who had reached Banasthali from Bardiya along with leaders and cadres to enter the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), was surrounded by women near the bell tower and beaten up. According to those close to the sect, the women had expressed anger over the non-return of the money they had taken during the election. The women, including Januka Poudel, a resident of Madhuban Municipality-7 in Bardiya, had assaulted her over an old financial transaction. In the video that has been released, the women are seen expressing anger at the Panth for not returning the money they took and for changing parties. They claimed that they had previously filed a complaint with the police but had not received a hearing. After the scuffle, the people with the cult tried to stop the women. After some tension, the police intervened, took the cult under control and calmed the women. After that, an attempt was made to settle the financial transaction in the presence of the police and the cult reportedly gave a check. Although the Panth party has admitted to taking money and making some payments, it has argued that it should not be tampered with in public places. There is a dispute between the two parties regarding the actual details of financial transactions and payments made during the election. Pantha was defeated by Resham Chaudhary's father in the 2079 House of Representatives election by a narrow margin. In the last election, he was defeated by Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) candidate Shreedhar Pokharel by a wide margin. Pantha, who has been advocating for the RSSSP in recent times, had reached Kathmandu in preparation to change parties and join the RSSSP.

राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टी (रास्वपा) प्रवेश गर्ने तयारीमा रहेका पन्थलाई काठमाडौँमा भेटेपछि रकम फिर्ता माग्दै चड्कन हानेकी जानुका पौडेलले शुक्रबार बैंकमा बुझ्न जाँदा खाता बन्द रहेको जानकारी पाएको बताइन् ।

पन्थले प्रहरीको रोहबरमा ९ लाख ५६ हजार, ७ लाख ५० हजार र २ लाख ५० हजार रुपैयाँका चेक दिएको पौडेलको भनाइ छ । तर, चेकमा उल्लेख भएको खाताबाट रकम भुक्तानी हुन नसक्ने भएपछि आफू फेरि समस्यामा परेको उनले बताइन् ।

पौडेलका अनुसार पन्थले २०७९ को निर्वाचनका बेला आफूबाट रकम लिएका थिए । उनले वित्तीय संस्थाबाट ऋण निकालेर, मितेनी तथा आफन्तसँग खोजेर रकम उपलब्ध गराएको बताइन् । लामो समयसम्म रकम फिर्ता नपाएपछि पन्थ रास्वपा प्रवेश गर्न लागेको थाहा पाएर काठमाडौँस्थित पार्टी कार्यालय पुगेको उनको भनाइ छ ।

‘म २०७९ को निर्वाचनपछि रास्वपामा थिएँ । निर्वाचनका बेला फाइनान्सबाट निकालेर, मितिनी र आफन्तसँग खोजेर दिएको रकम वर्षौंसम्म फिर्ता भएन । प्रहरीकहाँ बसेर हात जोड्दै चेक दिएपछि छाडेकी थिएँ । मैले ब्याज मागेको होइन, आफ्नै रकम फिर्ता पाउनुपर्छ’, पौडेलले भनिन् ।

आफू मात्रै नभई अरू पनि पन्थबाट पीडित रहेको दाबी गर्दै पौडेलले आफूले आवाज उठाएपछि थप पीडितहरू सम्पर्कमा आउन थालेको बताइन् ।

रकमको विवाद समाधान नभएसम्म पन्थलाई रास्वपा प्रवेश गर्न नदिन पार्टीका नेताहरूसँग आग्रह गरेको पनि उनले बताइन् ।

बर्दियामा तत्कालीन नेकपा (माओवादी) र हाल नेकपाबाट दुई पटक प्रतिनिधिसभा सदस्यका उम्मेदवार बनेका पन्थ रास्वपा प्रवेशको तयारीका क्रममा बुधबार काठमाडौँमा सार्वजनिक स्थानमै कुटिएका थिए । बर्दियाबाट नेता तथा कार्यकर्तासहित रास्वपा प्रवेश गर्न बनस्थली पुगेका पन्थलाई घण्टीघर नजिकै महिलाहरूले घेरेर हातपात गरेका थिए ।

पन्थ निकटस्थहरूका अनुसार निर्वाचनका बेला लिएको रकम फिर्ता नगरेको भन्दै महिलाहरूले आक्रोश पोखेका थिए । बर्दियाको मधुवन नगरपालिका–७ निवासी जानुका पौडेलसहितका महिलाले पुरानो आर्थिक लेनदेनको विषयलाई लिएर उनीमाथि हातपात गरेका थिए ।

सार्वजनिक भएको भिडियोमा महिलाहरूले पन्थमाथि रकम लिएर फिर्ता नगरेको र पार्टी परिवर्तन गर्दै हिँडेको भन्दै आक्रोश व्यक्त गरेको देखिन्छ ।

उनीहरूले यसअघि पनि प्रहरीमा उजुरी दिएको तर सुनुवाइ नभएको दाबी गरेका थिए ।

हातपातपछि पन्थसँग रहेका व्यक्तिहरूले महिलाहरूलाई रोक्ने प्रयास गरेका थिए । केहीबेर तनाव भएपछि प्रहरीले हस्तक्षेप गरी पन्थलाई नियन्त्रणमा लिएको र महिलाहरूलाई शान्त पारेको थियो । त्यसपछि प्रहरीकै रोहबरमा आर्थिक लेनदेन मिलाउने प्रयास भएको र पन्थले चेक दिएको बताइएको छ ।

पन्थ पक्षले रकम लिएको र केही भुक्तानीसमेत गरेको स्वीकार गरे पनि सार्वजनिक स्थानमा हातपात गर्न नहुने तर्क गरेको छ । निर्वाचनका बेला भएको आर्थिक कारोबारको वास्तविक विवरण र रकम भुक्तानीबारे दुवै पक्षबीच विवाद कायम छ ।

पन्थ २०७९ को प्रतिनिधिसभा निर्वाचनमा रेशम चौधरीका बुवासँग झिनो मतान्तरले पराजित भएका थिए । पछिल्लो निर्वाचनमा भने रास्वपाका उम्मेदवार श्रीधर पोखरेलसँग फराकिलो मतान्तरले पराजित भएका थिए । पछिल्लो समय रास्वपाको पक्षमा वकालत गर्दै आएका पन्थ पार्टी परिवर्तन गरी रास्वपा प्रवेश गर्ने तयारीमा काठमाडौं पुगेका थिए ।

Rupandehi. Bardiya NCP leader Suresh Pantha, who was publicly scolded over an old financial transaction dispute, handed over three checks worth Rs 1.95 million in the presence of the police, but the victim has claimed that the checks were from a closed account. Januka Poudel, who had been demanding a refund of the money after meeting Panth, who is preparing to join the National Independent Party (NISP), in Kathmandu, said that when she went to the bank on Friday to check, she was informed that the account was closed. Poudel said that Panth had given checks of Rs 956,000, Rs 750,000 and Rs 250,000 in the presence of the police. However, she said that she was in trouble again when the amount could not be paid from the account mentioned in the check. According to Poudel, Pantha had taken money from him during the 2079 elections. She said that she had taken out a loan from a financial institution and sought the money from her friends and relatives. She said that after not receiving the money back for a long time, she reached the party office in Kathmandu after learning that Pantha was going to join the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). "I was in the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) after the 2079 elections. The money I had withdrawn from finance during the elections, sought from my relatives and friends, was not returned for years. I left after sitting at the police station and giving a check with folded hands. I did not ask for interest, I should get my own money back," said Poudel. Claiming that not only she but others are victims of the cult, Poudel said that after she raised her voice, more victims started coming in contact. She also said that she has urged party leaders not to allow Panth to join the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) until the dispute over the money is resolved. Pantha, who was a two-time candidate for the House of Representatives from the then CPN (Maoist) in Bardiya and is currently a CPN member, was beaten up in a public place in Kathmandu on Wednesday while preparing to enter the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). Pantha, who had reached Banasthali from Bardiya along with leaders and cadres to enter the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), was surrounded by women near the bell tower and beaten up. According to those close to the sect, the women had expressed anger over the non-return of the money they had taken during the election. The women, including Januka Poudel, a resident of Madhuban Municipality-7 in Bardiya, had assaulted her over an old financial transaction. In the video that has been released, the women are seen expressing anger at the Panth for not returning the money they took and for changing parties. They claimed that they had previously filed a complaint with the police but had not received a hearing. After the scuffle, the people with the cult tried to stop the women. After some tension, the police intervened, took the cult under control and calmed the women. After that, an attempt was made to settle the financial transaction in the presence of the police and the cult reportedly gave a check. Although the Panth party has admitted to taking money and making some payments, it has argued that it should not be tampered with in public places. There is a dispute between the two parties regarding the actual details of financial transactions and payments made during the election. Pantha was defeated by Resham Chaudhary's father in the 2079 House of Representatives election by a narrow margin. In the last election, he was defeated by Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) candidate Shreedhar Pokharel by a wide margin. Pantha, who has been advocating for the RSSSP in recent times, had reached Kathmandu in preparation to change parties and join the RSSSP.
